topics.name: Scaling laws in micro- and nanosystems
Mechanics of thin films: residual stress, Stoney equation, delamination
Micro-beams, plates and membranes; electrostatic actuation and pull-in
MEMS resonators, damping and quality factor
Microfabrication of mechanical structures (lithography, etching, micro-molding)
Micro/nano-manufacturing: micro-machining, two-photon lithography, nanoimprint
Size effects in plasticity and strength at small scales
Nanoindentation and AFM-based mechanical characterisation
Microfluidics fundamentals
Micro/nanoscale heat transfer

chapters.name: Machine Learning & Digital Twins in Mechanical Engineering
chapters.summary: Using data and learning algorithms alongside physics models to simulate, monitor, design and control mechanical systems.

topics.name: Data-driven modelling of mechanical systems
Surrogate and reduced-order models for simulation
Physics-informed neural networks and scientific machine learning
Predictive maintenance and prognostics from sensor data
Digital twins of machines and production systems
Generative and AI-assisted design
Machine learning for manufacturing process monitoring and control
Machine-learning-driven discovery of materials and structures
